findings.evidence: Basic.lean:1090-1099 vs Decomposition.lean:107-116 — same `refine ⟨Bilin.reflect g u ∘ₗ Bilin.reflect g …⟩` skeleton and the same `by_cases hfin : Module.Finite ℝ V` / `LinearMap.det_eq_one_of_not_module_finite` branch with the same comment text.
findings.fix: Add one lemma in Basic.lean, e.g. `reflect_comp_reflect_isKinematicStabilizer (hSymm) (huq huT hu) (hu'q hu'T hu') : IsKinematicStabilizer g K (Bilin.reflect g u ∘ₗ Bilin.reflect g u') ∧ LinearMap.det (…) = 1`, and have both `exists_half_turn` and `exists_quarter_turn` call it; each then only supplies its own action on `u`, `u'`. Net line count in Basic.lean is roughly unchanged (1416 of 1500), so the file-length constraint does not block this.
findings.issue: Lines 91-116 of `exists_quarter_turn` duplicate `Hadronic.exists_half_turn` (Basic.lean:1085-1099) nearly character for character: the two `reflect_isKinematicStabilizer` applications, the `refine ⟨reflect g _ ∘ₗ reflect g _, ⟨fun v w => by simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, h₁.isometry _ _, h₂.isometry _ _], …fixes_p, …fixes_q⟩⟩` block, and the `by_cases hfin : Module.Finite ℝ V` determinant branch with the identical comment. The reusable fact — a composite of two reflections in non-null spectator directions is a determinant-one kinematic stabilizer — is left implicit in both copies.

findings.evidence: Decomposition.lean:261-276; `hA₁₂` and `he₁` appear nowhere else in the proof body, and `ring` at 276 is outside the `<;>` chain so it applies to the main goal only.
findings.fix: Replace the `<;>` chain with three `·` bullets, one per component equation, each with its own `simp only`/`field_simp`/`ring`, and pass the non-vanishing facts explicitly, e.g. `field_simp [hA₁₂, he₁, hTT]`, rather than leaving them to the discharger. Naming the two coefficient expressions with `set`/`have` before the `refine` would also make the 3-line term at 264-266 readable.
findings.issue: `refine ⟨…, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp only [...] <;> field_simp` followed by a bare `ring` closes the three component identities (`(p_T,p_T)`, `(e₁,e₁)`, `(e₁,e₂)`) as one chain; `ring` runs on whichever single goal `field_simp` happened not to discharge, so the reader cannot tell which goal needs the arithmetic and any change in `field_simp` output breaks the script with "no goals" or unsolved goals. Compounding this, `hA₁₂` (line 261), `he₁` (262) and `hTT` are never referenced: they exist only to be picked up by `field_simp`'s `assumption` discharger.

summary: Two proof-quality issues: the composite-of-two-reflections construction is copied verbatim from `exists_half_turn` instead of factored into a shared lemma, and the main existence proof merges three structurally different component goals into one `<;>` chain with a trailing bare `ring`, hiding which goal needs what and relying on unnamed context hypotheses for `field_simp`'s discharger.
